einzeiler: The objective reality of Jesus's miracles in Matthew 14-17.
kurzfassung: Fr. Mike examines the miracles of Jesus found in the readings from Matthew 14-17 and Proverbs 19. He discusses the objective reality of these events and how Jesus demonstrates power over matter as the Son of God. Additionally, the episode explores how believers can accomplish things through Jesus that would otherwise be impossible.
stichpunkte: The objective reality of the miracles performed by Jesus
Jesus as the Son of God with power over matter
How believers can achieve things through Jesus beyond their own capacity
beschreibung:
As we read about the many miracles Jesus performs in today's readings from Matthew, Fr. Mike asserts the objective reality of those miracles and reinforces that Jesus is truly the Son of God who has power over matter. We learn that in Jesus, we too can do things that we could never do on our own. Today's readings are Matthew 14-17, and Proverbs 19:9-12.

For the complete reading plan, visit ascensionpress.com/bibleinayear.

Please note: The Bible contains adult themes that may not be suitable for children - parental discretion is advised.
